title: Delegation tool must be auto-approved for a fan-out command
expected_outcome: With the delegation tool disallowed the coordinator cannot spawn the reviewer; with Agent allowed the subagent runs and its answer comes back.

tool_input.description: List project and user agent definitions

t2.result: VERDICT: Needs changes: `validateQuantity` in `<course>/UC-25-1qkucnto/workspace/src/utils/quantity.js` accepts zero and negative integers. A quantity of -5 or 0 passes validation and reaches the repository, which could corrupt order totals or stock. It needs a `qty >= 1` check and probably a maximum. It also lacks the tests the project standards require (expected, edge and failure cases).

evaluation.criterion: without the delegation tool the fan-out cannot happen
with Agent (Task before v2.1.63) in the allowed list the reviewer's verdict comes back
learner can state that allowedTools auto-approves and is not a hard allowlist
